🦠 VIRUS PARASITE SIMULATOR - INFECT THE WORLD! 🦠

You are a deadly virus. Spread your infection, eat every human and start a pandemic before you starve!

🧬 9 STRAINS
Fission, Organic, Stinger, Mutant, Pyro, Slime, Burrower, Octopus + the LIMITED Matrix (0.01%)! Roll MUTATIONS: Prism, Fungus, Frostbite!

🗺️ 7 MAPS
Village, City, Snow Town, Autumn Valley, Desert Outpost, the Mines and Military Base.

💀 4 DIFFICULTIES
Easy, Normal, Hard and NIGHTMARE. Survivors dodge, run and fight back!

⭐ FEATURES
• Evolve with DNA mid-match
• 30+ titles - some SECRET!
• DAILY leaderboard - top 3 win a title
• Play with friends
• Daily rewards and free gifts

🔥 Outbreak, infection, plague, epidemic, bacteria, germ, evolution, survival!

1.9 The Matrix Update
- New Limited Matrix Strain!

👍 Like + ⭐ Favorite to be ready!
